description: PDF upload step 1 of 3 (prepare -> PUT -> finalize): reserve the draft source at expectedRevision and mint a short-lived signed PUT (contentType application/pdf, at most 52428800 bytes). result.upload.url is a one-time transit secret, listed in the result _meta["opentrain/sensitive"]: PUT the bytes there with result.upload.method and result.upload.headers before result.upload.expiresAt, and never log, persist or echo it. Replaying the key mints a fresh URL for the same reservation. This tool never carries file bytes. Requires agreements:write. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Same key + same payload replays the stored outcome (replayed: true); same key + a changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_agreements_documents_upload_prepare
